title: Hearty Spicy Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice
description: A peppery and silky Jamaican dish featuring sunflower oil, perfect for a midnight craving, this low-carb-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional fried rice, incorporating Jamaican spices and flavors.
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet pepper and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the jamaican seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
